question: Who took over as the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India in December 2024?
solution: The correct answer is __**Sanjay Malhotra**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Sanjay Malhotra** took over as the **Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** in **December 2024**, succeeding the previous Governor, Shaktikanta Das. • He is a senior bureaucrat with extensive experience in the financial and administrative sectors, having served in various capacities in key government ministries. • As the **25th Governor of RBI**, Sanjay Malhotra is expected to focus on maintaining monetary stability, addressing inflation, and supporting economic growth in India. • The appointment of Sanjay Malhotra aligns with the government’s vision of ensuring robust financial management and effective implementation of monetary policies. • His tenure will also involve steering the Indian economy through global challenges, including economic slowdowns and geopolitical uncertainties.
